title: PQ cross-domain parity reconciliation after Super Soul endpoint recovery
findings: The two Batch 747 Super Soul endpoint gaps are now fully resolved in the live canonical layer: PQ54 maps to super-soul-181 and PQ57 maps to super-soul-184.
The forward PQ layer contains no Super Soul reward names lacking canonical Super Soul endpoints.

The PQ skill crosslink report contained one stale derived entry: PQ57 Rakshasa's Claw was listed as a skill even though the canonical PQ forward record classifies it as equipment. The derived report was corrected; canonical skill/equipment data was not altered.
Canonical equipment forward parity is complete for equipment names that have exact endpoints in the equipment record layer.

changes.reason: Stale derived classification; canonical PQ57 classifies Rakshasa's Claw as equipment.

rules: Canonical forward PQ data remains authoritative.
Derived reports are reconciled to canonical classification rather than used as source of truth.
No reward probability, guarantee, or Ultimate-Finish-only status was inferred.
